params.name: organization_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization.

params.name: file_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the file to download.

items.docs:
Download a file by its unique file ID. Files are typically attachments that have been uploaded to the system and associated with various entities like policies, claims, applications, etc.

Note: A filename can optionally be appended to the URL for readability (e.g., `/apps/{organization_id}/files/download/{file_id}/report.pdf`), but it is not used for file identification.
